findings.problem: Child source maps used bare filenames while parent validator required repository-relative keys; child precheck omitted required source map and expected node inventory.
findings.resolution: Emit one normalized complete map in every child receipt and required precheck fields.

findings.problem: Latest input copied another run's candidate-4 execution binding; four current source hashes differed. No current-source completion receipts existed.
findings.resolution: Create an isolated owned request/registry and candidate binding. Superseding this owned codex candidate archives predecessor bytes and uses safe task/run IDs.

findings.problem: Delivery writer returned inventory digest, then main overwrote that file with a final seal, invalidating receipt reference.
findings.resolution: Per-invocation immutable counts and inventory with explicit receipt paths; final manifest sealed after outer launch output closes.

findings.problem: SIMULATED_CAPTURE early rejection prevented negative fixture assertions from exercising child binding/guard checks.
findings.resolution: Keep synthetic provenance as non-success while validating child artifacts and asserting the specific binding/guard rejection reason.
